454八荒（第12页）齐知玄福至心灵，大彻大悟。谁能料到，困扰他的修行难题竟从太子殿下的记忆片段中找到了答案。“要想晋升八荒，就必须凝练识海世界，大脑不再充当实体器官。”“具体修炼方法：五宝炼神，开天辟地。”“好好好！”齐知玄心中有数了，心情前所未有的振奋。随即他隐匿自土地开始翻滚，宛如煮沸的粥，混合着泥浆沙砾，不断的呼啸汹涌，向龟伯扑去，可是龟伯守着脚下一方净土，不动不摇，稳固的在其中，可是现在只是地劫三变中第一变，而随后的两变会更加的艰险。不过也不是李灵一急于求成，实在是本来就没多少时间。尤其是这么多人每多拖一天就多一分暴露的危险，如果他们被赫伦堡那些士兵发现，绝对会加强防御，到时候就更加艰难了。“好”，团长就面无表情的吐出一个字，没有再作安排，也没有向任何人打招呼，竟自顾自的转身离去。幽冥血海煞气漫天，无数滔天巨浪翻涌而起，道道雷霆万钧，狂风呼啸。白雪也明白这个道理，很多人表面上看着光鲜亮丽，可拆去那层美丽的包装纸，看到的便是血淋淋的现实，尤其是黑道上的朋友。白雪暗想这四人应该便是冷血七杀里面的四个，若是每一个都有那骷髅怪人陆天一一般的武力，那么遇上再大的事情也能挡一挡了，龙鹰侯看来也下了血本。这样，我们一直等到天色放亮，除了室内较为阴冷之外，倒是再也没有任何异常！我们也只得收兵回营。当然，天无绝人之路，天下之事生死相克，根本就没有解决不了的问题。像什么僵尸鬼怪﹑千年蛇妖尚有降它之人，更别说是三个厉鬼啦。（请）454八荒（第22页）奇拉比喊着，身体也如同炮弹一样骤然弹射而来，速度比之前完全高了一个档次，超越了音速，瞬间就来到李灵一面前，一记直拳朝着他的脑袋轰来。“切，我会让你知道南宫家的威力的。”南宫天看着月夜十分不屑的道。待得苏宇几人离开此处洞窟抵达洞口之后，皆是大大松了口气，先前的经历如同噩梦在他们心中环绕，如今就算脱线心里也一阵后怕，若不是有那魔魂口中所说的封魔玄阵他们也不可能逃脱出来。想到这里，在洞口设置禁制之后，猛灌了一口混元仙酿，顿时感到一股澎湃的灵气骤然充斥全身。那带着纹龙面具的黑衣人出低沉的声音，看着那巨大神像头顶上的沐风和神目珑两人，眼中迸出一道强烈的寒芒。房门被踢开的那一刹，镜头卡嚓卡嚓声响了一片，人人都要努力的拍下这刺激的场面。“哥，为什么？为什么你要这样做？”朱锦绣抱着他的哥哥说道，而朱锦程奄奄一息的躺在他的怀中，看着他的样子很惨，但是脸上却浮现出温柔的目光看着他，作为中了病毒成为醒尸的他根本就不能说话。官当到他这样的程度，见过的军人实在太多，很多都只是一面之缘而已，魏大虎现在还对人有些印象，算是记忆力十分的不错。林寒的目光如同猎鹰一般的锐利，瞬时间，林寒就便是一个鲤鱼打滚，就便是从地面之上翻了起来，随后，林寒的目标也是瞬间的锁定了那庞大的骷髅。

> 454 Eight Wastelands (Page 1)
454 Bahuang (page 12) Qi Zhi Xuan Fu reaches the soul, and has great enlightenment. Who could have expected that the answer to the difficult spiritual problem that troubled him would be found in the memory fragments of His Royal Highness. "If you want to be promoted to the Eight Wildernesses, you must condense the world of consciousness, and the brain will no longer serve as a physical organ." "The specific cultivation method: refine the gods with five treasures and create the world." "Okay, okay!" Qi Zhixuan knew what he was doing, and he felt more excited than ever before. Then he disappeared from the ground and began to roll, like boiling porridge, mixed with mud and gravel, roaring and surging continuously, rushing towards Gui Bo, but Gui Bo guarded the pure land at his feet, unshakable and stable in it, but now it was only the first of the three changes of the Earth Tribulation, and the subsequent two changes would be even more difficult and dangerous. But it's not that Li Lingyi is in a hurry for success, he really doesn't have much time in the first place. Especially since so many people are at greater risk of being exposed every extra day they delay. If they are discovered by the soldiers at Harrenhal, they will definitely strengthen their defenses, and it will be even more difficult then. "Okay", the group leader said one word expressionlessly, without making any further arrangements or saying hello to anyone, he turned around and left. The evil spirit of the Netherworld Blood Sea fills the sky, countless huge waves surge into the sky, there are thunderous waves and howling winds. Bai Xue also understands this truth. Many people look glamorous on the surface, but when you remove the beautiful wrapping paper, what you see is the bloody reality, especially friends in the underworld. Bai Xue secretly thought that these four people should be the four in the Cold-Blooded Seven Kills. If each of them had the same strength as the skeleton monster Lu Tianyi, they would be able to block any big thing. It seems that Long Yinghou also spent a lot of money. In this way, we waited until the sky got brighter, and except that the room was colder, there was nothing unusual! We had no choice but to withdraw our troops and return to camp. Of course, there is no perfect path for everyone, and there is no problem in the world that cannot be solved. Like zombies, ghosts, thousand-year-old snake monsters, and people who can subjugate them, not to mention three fierce ghosts. (Please) 454 Bahuang (page 22) Kirabi shouted, and his body suddenly ejected like a cannonball. The speed was completely higher than before, surpassing the speed of sound. He came to Li Lingyi in an instant and punched him in the head. "Tch, I will let you know the power of the Nangong family." Nangong Tian said with disdain as he looked at Yue Ye. After Su Yu and the others left the cave and arrived at the entrance, they all breathed a sigh of relief. The previous experiences were like nightmares in their hearts. Now, even if they were offline, they felt scared. If it weren't for the Demon Sealing Array mentioned by the demon soul, they would not have been able to escape. Thinking of this, after setting up a restriction at the entrance of the cave, he took a sip of Hunyuan Immortal Brew and suddenly felt a surge of spiritual energy suddenly filling his body. The man in black with the dragon mask made a deep voice, and looked at Mu Feng and Shen Mulong above the giant statue, with a strong cold light bursting out of his eyes. The moment the door was kicked open, the camera made a clicking sound, and everyone had to work hard to capture this exciting scene. "Brother, why? Why are you doing this?" Zhu Jinxiu said while holding his brother, while Zhu Jincheng lay dying in his arms, looking at him miserable, but with a gentle look on his face. As a virus-ridden corpse, he couldn't speak at all. At this level of official service, he has met too many soldiers, many of whom were just casual encounters. Wei Dahu still has some impressions of people, and his memory is considered to be very good. Lin Han's eyes were as sharp as a falcon. In an instant, Lin Han was like a carp rolling and flipping up from the ground. Then, Lin Han's target was also instantaneous.Locked on the huge skeleton.
